card.name: Inside amateur, premature, miniature words
card.fires_on: The ending of words built on a stem like 'prem-' or 'mini-' (premature, miniature, miniaturized) and the whole word 'amateur'. It is strongest in all-caps warning headings and in sports or hobby descriptions.

modes.label: Premature/miniature endings
modes.description: The closing piece of premature or miniature, often in capitalized warning headings.

modes.label: The word amateur
modes.description: The word amateur describing a team, champion, or painter.
modes.example: was the undisputed<< amateur>> champion of the state.
